anydiff.command.compareMultipleFiles: Compare Selected Files with Each Other
anydiff.language: Interface language. `auto` follows the VSCode UI language.
anydiff.ignoreTrimWhitespace: Ignore leading and trailing whitespace when comparing.
anydiff.ignoreAllWhitespace: Ignore all whitespace changes when comparing.
anydiff.clipboardHistoryLimit: Maximum number of clipboard entries kept in history.
anydiff.maxFileSizeMB: Warn before comparing files larger than this size (in MB).
anydiff.showStatsNotification: Show `+/-` line counts in the status bar after a comparison.
